prompt: Find up to 5 sent campaigns whose subject line (case-insensitive) contains the word 'sale'. Put the answer inside `final_answer` as a JSON array of objects, each with fields: id, name, subject_line. If fewer than 5 exist, return however many were found (but at least 1).

claims.description: each item has id, name, subject_line

claims.expected: Every campaign listed has the word 'sale' (case-insensitive) somewhere in its subject_line field. The list should not be empty.

notes: Tests filtering inside a list response. dtc-mcp can do this in one execute_code call; klaviyo-mcp likely needs to fetch all + filter client-side.
